caption:
Cash-on-cash return is a straightforward metric that many commercial investors, landlords, building owners, and business owners use to evaluate annual cash performance. It compares the annual pre-tax cash flow you actually receive to the cash equity you put into a deal. For investors in Chester County and Montgomery County this helps prioritize properties that meet income needs, compare financing structures, and set expectations for distributions or reinvestment. Always include operating expenses and debt service in your cash calculations and remember this metric excludes non-cash items like depreciation, and it does not reflect long‑term appreciation or tax effects.
